title: Job search under basic-auth must be narrowed to the caller's creator
answers: non-admin user sees other users' jobs in job search under basic-auth
POST /ajax-api/3.0/jobs/search returns every job to any authenticated user
job listing leaks other users' job params and results while get-by-id returns 403
enumerate other users' job ids through the jobs search API
body:
Symptom: under --app-name basic-auth, a non-admin user searching jobs sees other users' job ids, params, and result/error text, although fetching the same job by id returns 403.
Root cause: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS had no entry for mlflow/server/job_api.py:search_jobs, so the POST search returned the unfiltered store listing.
Fix pattern: expose creator on mlflow/server/job_api.py:Job (set in from_job_entity), add a response filter that keeps only jobs whose creator equals the username, and register it keyed on the search_jobs endpoint function.
Constraints: jobs with no recorded creator (legacy rows, worker-spawned child jobs) stay hidden from non-admins, matching the per-id ownership check. Admins skip response filters in fastapi_permission_middleware and keep the full listing. Post-response filtering is only complete while the search handler returns the full, unpaginated result set.
applies: Job-related FastAPI collection routes in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py under basic-auth; not the per-id get/cancel routes, which use the route validator.
says: Non-admin users can see other people's background jobs in search results.
Job search results reveal parameters and outputs from jobs created by other users.
Restrict the jobs list so team members only view their own submitted tasks.
Searching jobs exposes execution logs and error messages from all workspace users.
Standard users can browse all background execution jobs despite lacking individual permissions.
search: Under basic-auth, mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py must filter search_jobs responses from mlflow/server/job_api.py so non-admin users only receive jobs where creator matches their username. The creator property is exposed on mlflow/server/job_api.py:Job via from_job_entity and filtered through FASTAPI_ENDPOINT_RESPONSE_FILTERS registered for search_jobs. Jobs without recorded creators remain hidden from non-admins, while administrators bypass fastapi_permission_middleware filters to receive the complete listing. Applies to job-related FastAPI collection routes under basic-auth and relies on search handlers returning unpaginated result sets.
